bind-key -n M-h display-popup -E -w 70% -h 70% "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem help"
bind-key -n C-M-n display-popup -E -w 90% -h 90% "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem add-agent"
bind-key -n M-Up run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem tab prev"
bind-key -n M-Down run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem tab next"
bind-key -n M-s run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem focus status"
bind-key -n M-q run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem focus queries"
bind-key -n M-1 run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem focus planner"
bind-key -n M-2 run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem focus implementer"
bind-key -n C-M-w confirm-before -p 'Close this agent? (y/n)' "run-shell -b \"env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem close-agent\""
bind-key -n C-M-x run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem quit"
bind-key -n C-M-r run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem restart"
bind-key -n C-M-z switch-client -T tandem-resize
bind-key -n M-b run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem focus sidebar"
bind-key -n M-, run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem focus settings"
bind-key -n M-PageDown run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem grid-scroll 1"
bind-key -n M-NPage run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem grid-scroll 1"
bind-key -n M-PageUp run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem grid-scroll -1"
bind-key -n M-PPage run-shell -b "env TANDEM_WORKSPACE=/mock/workspace /usr/local/bin/tandem grid-scroll -1"
